eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Infrastructure] ElasticOOMCircuitBreaker
eventTemplate.description:
Elasticsearch's OutOfMemory-prevention circuit breaker is tripping at > 0.5 trips/s for 30 minutes in namespace {dims} — applications might not be functioning correctly (generation updates not completing, inconsistent data, importer lagging behind). This is an early-warning signal; other issues on the cluster may show up hours or days later — investigate if it triggers.

Uses the underscored Prometheus spelling — same collector-scrape reasoning as elastic-high-shards.json.
